description: This Java class 'ContactHelper' provides utility methods for accessing and formatting contact mechanism data related to parties, including retrieving contact mechanisms by type or purpose, and formatting credit card information.

classes.name: ContactHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to retrieve and format contact mechanism data for parties.

methods.name: getContactMech
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party, optionally filtered by purpose and type, including or excluding old records.

methods.name: getContactMechByType
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism type.

methods.name: getContactMechByPurpose
methods.description: Retrieves contact mechanisms for a party filtered by contact mechanism purpose.

methods.name: formatCreditCard
methods.description: Formats credit card information into a string showing card type, last four digits, and expiration date.
